reports.title: Lennox Reports 2026 Third Quarter Earnings Results

guidance.heading: FULL YEAR 2026 GUIDANCE
section: For full year 2026, we are revising the revenue growth guidance at approximately 6% growth, including 5% benefit from completed acquisitions.
Adjusted earnings per share guidance has been updated to a range of $21.00 to $21.50 compared to the prior range of $23.00 to $24.00.
Free cash flow guidance updated to $700 million to $750 million.
